### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

01
Exploits don’t wait.

With thousands of findings flooding security queues, most teams struggle to tell which risks really
matter. At the same time, attackers can now use AI to create exploits in minutes, turning overlooked
vulnerabilities into real threats much faster.

02
AI can’t secure itself.

AI assistants are now writing code faster than humans can review it. Without an independent security
check, vulnerable code can go straight into production.

03
Old tools miss new threats.

Engineering teams grew 75%, but AppSec budgets didn’t keep pace. As security tools create more
friction for developers, they get worked around, compounding security gaps and backlogs.

04
Audits won’t wait.

AI assets, models, and MCP servers are growing faster than teams can track. NIS2 and DORA are
already in force, with CRA starting in 2027. By the time the audit starts, it’s already too late to
catch up.

## Beyond Detection.

Alerts aren’t enough. Teams need full visibility: what was found, fixed, deferred, and approved.

### Coverage

Most tools secure in silos. Checkmarx covers code creation, CI/CD, AI supply chain, and runtime —
with MCP, IDE, and PR hooks that enforce security at every agentic control point.

[Shield AI Security][Shield AI Security]

### Signal Quality

Raw findings aren’t actionable. Checkmarx combines deterministic precision with AI analysis to
surface true positives, ranked by reachability, exploitability, and business context.

[Fast][Fast]

### Remediation Velocity

Discovery without fixing just grows the backlog. Checkmarx delivers AI-generated, merge-ready fixes
at the point of code creation for 50% faster MTTR, 30–50% fewer duplicate fixes, and zero AppSec
headcount increase.

[Supply Chain][Supply Chain]

### AI Supply Chain Visibility

Traditional AppSec wasn’t built to detect AI. Checkmarx inventories and governs every model, MCP
server, agent, SDK, dataset, prompt, and AI dependency in your pipeline — before it becomes a blind
spot.

[Shield Code][Shield Code]

### Developer-First

When tools create friction, developers route around them. Checkmarx surfaces findings with fix
proposals already attached — no context-switching, no investigation.

[Compliance-Ready-V2][Compliance-Ready-V2]

### Audit-Ready

Knowing what was found isn’t enough. Checkmarx maintains documented records of every finding,
decision, exception, and approval to ensure human oversight is built into the process, not bolted on
after.

# Needs Agentic Security.

with agentic AI application security.

01
Exploits don’t wait.

With thousands of findings flooding security queues, most teams struggle to tell which risks really
matter. At the same time, attackers can now use AI to create exploits in minutes, turning overlooked
vulnerabilities into real threats much faster.

02
AI can’t secure itself.

AI assistants are now writing code faster than humans can review it. Without an independent security
check, vulnerable code can go straight into production.

03
Old tools miss new threats.

Engineering teams grew 75%, but AppSec budgets didn’t keep pace. As security tools create more
friction for developers, they get worked around, compounding security gaps and backlogs.

04
Audits won’t wait.

AI assets, models, and MCP servers are growing faster than teams can track. NIS2 and DORA are
already in force, with CRA starting in 2027. By the time the audit starts, it’s already too late to
catch up.

governed remediation — delivered through a hybrid engine built for every stage of the AI-driven

## AI Application Security That Goes
## Beyond Detection.

Alerts aren’t enough. Teams need full visibility: what was found, fixed, deferred, and approved.

[Real-Time-Monitoring-1][Real-Time-Monitoring-1]

### Coverage

Most tools secure in silos. Checkmarx covers code creation, CI/CD, AI supply chain, and runtime —
with MCP, IDE, and PR hooks that enforce security at every agentic control point.

[Shield AI Security][Shield AI Security]

### Signal Quality

Raw findings aren’t actionable. Checkmarx combines deterministic precision with AI analysis to
surface true positives, ranked by reachability, exploitability, and business context.

[Fast][Fast]

### Remediation Velocity

Discovery without fixing just grows the backlog. Checkmarx delivers AI-generated, merge-ready fixes
at the point of code creation for 50% faster MTTR, 30–50% fewer duplicate fixes, and zero AppSec
headcount increase.

[Supply Chain][Supply Chain]

### AI Supply Chain Visibility

Traditional AppSec wasn’t built to detect AI. Checkmarx inventories and governs every model, MCP
server, agent, SDK, dataset, prompt, and AI dependency in your pipeline — before it becomes a blind
spot.

[Shield Code][Shield Code]

### Developer-First

When tools create friction, developers route around them. Checkmarx surfaces findings with fix
proposals already attached — no context-switching, no investigation.

[Compliance-Ready-V2][Compliance-Ready-V2]

### Audit-Ready

Knowing what was found isn’t enough. Checkmarx maintains documented records of every finding,
decision, exception, and approval to ensure human oversight is built into the process, not bolted on
after.

certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of

ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

[tick icon]

`Career Opportunities`

### ASCMI’s Certification Will Get You Practical Skills That Set You Apart

Hiring managers don’t want memorized facts. They want proven defenders.You’ll graduate with a
portfolio, a toolkit, and the battle scars that prove you’re ready to own a cybersecurity career.
* #### CTF Challenges
  
  Capture the flag scenarios that sharpen real-time hacking and defense instincts.
* #### Capstone Breach Simulation
  
  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a
  simulated boardroom defense briefing.
* #### SIEM and Threat Hunting Labs
  
  Master tools like Splunk and Elastic for threat detection, response, and proactive hunting.
* #### Penetration Testing Playbooks
  
  Go beyond theory with full-scope penetration testing across cloud, mobile, network, and IoT
  landscapes.
* #### Cloud Security Deployments
  
  Build multi-layered defenses in AWS, Azure, and hybrid clouds with live case studies.

[ ➔ Get Started ][97]

`how it works`

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

`What You Will Learn`

## How You’ll Learn: Fast-Track or Flex Through ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification

Your life isn’t on pause, and your career ambitions shouldn’t be either. That’s why ACSMI’s Advanced
Cybersecurity & Management Certification gives you complete control over your timeline:

Both tracks deliver **the same powerhouse curriculum**, labs, capstone defense, and certification
preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

[Fast-Track Option]

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured
bootcamp experience, perfect for career changers and go-getters ready to dive in.

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Self-Paced Flexibility

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or
existing studies, with no deadlines locking you down.

`Who Needs Us`

### Who ACSMI’s Dual Cybersecurity & Management Certification Is Built For

Cybersecurity has no one-size-fits-all, and neither does ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
Certification. Wherever you're starting, ACSMI doesn’t just prepare you for a cybersecurity job —
**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

[College Graduates]

#### **College Graduates**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

[Career Changers]

#### **Career Changers**

Break into cybersecurity fast with practical, recognized certification and hands-on proof you can
deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

Specialize and pivot toward six-figure cybersecurity roles, cloud security, ethical hacking, or
threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

Move up from daily tasks to high-level strategic defense, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

[Aspiring CISOs]

#### **Aspiring CISOs**

Learn governance, budgeting, and security operations leadership to transition into decision-maker
roles.

`who is it for`

### Who Hires Cybersecurity Specialists With ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
### Certification?

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified
professionals are equipped to lead across them all.

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

## We prioritize alerts so you don’t have to.

### Deduplication

Related alerts are grouped together, so you can resolve more issues with less effort.

### AutoTriage

Aikido evaluates alerts in the context of your code and infrastructure and deprioritizes issues that
do not pose real risk to your application.

### Custom Rules

Fine tune what is relevant for your team. Exclude specific paths, packages, or conditions while
still being alerted when something critical happens.

[down arrow]

## We help you go from alert to fix.

### AutoFix

Generate reviewable pull requests to fix issues across code, dependencies, infrastructure, and
containers, with full visibility before you merge.

### Bulk Fix with One Click

Create ready to merge pull requests that address multiple related alerts at once, saving time and
manual work.

### TL;DR Summaries

Get a short, actionable summary of what’s wrong and how to fix it. Turn it into a ticket or assign
it in one click.

4

5

## We prioritize alerts so you don’t have to.

### Deduplication

Related alerts are grouped together, so you can resolve more issues with less effort.

### AutoTriage

Aikido evaluates alerts in the context of your code and infrastructure and deprioritizes issues that
do not pose real risk to your application.

### Custom Rules

Fine tune what is relevant for your team. Exclude specific paths, packages, or conditions while
still being alerted when something critical happens.

[down arrow]

## We help you go from alert to fix.

### AutoFix

Generate reviewable pull requests to fix issues across code, dependencies, infrastructure, and
containers, with full visibility before you merge.

### Bulk Fix with One Click

Create ready to merge pull requests that address multiple related alerts at once, saving time and
manual work.

### TL;DR Summaries

Get a short, actionable summary of what’s wrong and how to fix it. Turn it into a ticket or assign
it in one click.

2

### Short-lived access tokens

4

5

Every scan generates a separate docker container which gets hard-deleted right after analysis is
done.

## Eight years on the vendor side. Now on yours.

I spent eight years selling application-security tools — thousands of evaluations and demos. I know
the landscape, the pricing, and the trade-offs from the inside. So I judge every tool the same way,
against what a buyer actually needs, then tell you who it really fits.

No pay-to-rank, ever Sponsorship never sways a review Insider, not adversary

Deeper benchmarks & original data live in a separate [Research][135] track — reproducible studies
with open methodology and published data.

01What does it actually cost? Published numbers · real-scale tiers · no ‘contact sales’ guesswork

04Does it fit your stack? CI · IDEs · how portable you stay
05Where does it stand? Maturity · traction · momentum

### Qualifizierung

Unsere Profilierung

Recherchieren Sie schneller und gezielter mit unserem branchenspezifischen Themensystem – präziser
als klassische Schlagwort- oder CPV-Suchen. Erhalten Sie mobil optimierten Zugriff auf relevante
Informationen und profitieren Sie von KI-gestützten Zusammenfassungen komplexer Unterlagen.
Integrieren Sie externe Systeme nahtlos über leistungsfähige API-Schnittstellen.

AM
Alice Müller

Organisator

### Zusammenarbeit

Unser Teamangebot

Ausschreibungsmanagement ist Teamarbeit zwischen Administration und Vertrieb. Personen mit
unterschiedlichen Aufgaben müssen wir also auch unterschiedliche Sichtweisen auf die Ergebnisse
anbieten. Unser Portal unterstützt Sie bei dieser Teambildung durch Zuweisung von Nutzerrollen mit
klaren Rechten und Verantwortlichkeiten.

### Service

Unser Support

Schon in der Testphase überzeugen wir Sie von unserem Support-Angebot, indem wir mit Ihnen gemeinsam
nach entsprechenden Erläuterungen die Möglichkeiten auf unserem Portal so einstellen, dass für Sie
der optimale Nutzen entsteht. Auch später, bei einer weiteren Zusammenarbeit steht Ihnen Ihr
persönlicher Ansprechpartner telefonisch oder per Mail zur Verfügung.

### Funktionen der Profilierung

Das Auftrag Select Portal bietet Ihnen eine Vielzahl leistungsstarker Funktionen - für den gezielten
Bezug und die effiziente Verwaltung Ihrer Ergebnisse. Flexible Optionen unterstützen Ihre internen

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

## FAQ
* What application security and open source risk management solutions does Black Duck offer?
  
  Black Duck is the leader in application security testing, offering [True Scale Application
  Security][121] that empowers organizations to build trust in their software. We provide a
  comprehensive suite of automated application security solutions, including agentic AI AppSec,
  static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST),
  interactive application security testing (IAST), and software composition analysis (SCA), to
  identify, manage, and remediate security vulnerabilities, license compliance risks, and code
  quality issues across the entire software development life cycle.
  
  By integrating seamlessly into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines, Black Duck solutions
  enable teams to secure proprietary and open source components as well as AI-generated code,
  accelerate secure software delivery, and ensure compliance with industry regulations. Black Duck
  provides the visibility, automation, and expert guidance necessary to manage software security
  risks at the speed modern businesses demand.
* How do Black Duck SCA tools protect and monitor software supply chain security and open source
  components?
  
  Black Duck offers comprehensive [software composition analysis (SCA)][122] tools that provide
  complete visibility into every open source and third-party component in your applications. Our
  advanced detection methods can also generate and manage accurate Software Bills of Materials
  (SBOMs), meticulously tracking components and their versions, licenses, and security status to
  ensure transparency and compliance with supply chain regulations. Black Duck continuously monitors
  these components against vulnerability databases, including our proprietary [KnowledgeBase][123]™,
  and automatically alerts your teams to new threats without requiring new scans. By integrating
  directly into CI/CD pipelines, Black Duck solutions prevent vulnerable or noncompliant code from
  advancing, ensuring ongoing supply chain security and enabling rapid response to emerging threats
  and attacks.
* What SAST, DAST, SCA, and AI AppSec testing tools does Black Duck offer?
  
  Black Duck provides a comprehensive and complementary portfolio of application security testing
  (AST) solutions designed to secure both proprietary code and third-party components, including
  AI-generated code, across the entire software development life cycle. Our offerings include
  * **Agentic AI application security.** [Black Duck Signal™][124] combines 20+ years of software
    security expertise and intellectual property with LLM-powered software analysis to autonomously
    detect and remediate vulnerabilities in business-critical applications.
  * **Static application security testing (SAST).** [Black Duck SAST tools][125] provide fast,
    scalable, and comprehensive static code analysis in the cloud ([Polaris fAST Static][126]), on
    premises ([Coverity^{®} Static Analysis][127]), and at the developer desktop ([CodeSight™ IDE
    Plug-in][128]).

## FAQ
* What application security and open source risk management solutions does Black Duck offer?
  
  Black Duck is the leader in application security testing, offering [True Scale Application
  Security][121] that empowers organizations to build trust in their software. We provide a
  comprehensive suite of automated application security solutions, including agentic AI AppSec,
  static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST),
  interactive application security testing (IAST), and software composition analysis (SCA), to
  identify, manage, and remediate security vulnerabilities, license compliance risks, and code
  quality issues across the entire software development life cycle.
  
  By integrating seamlessly into developer workflows and CI/CD pipelines, Black Duck solutions
  enable teams to secure proprietary and open source components as well as AI-generated code,
  accelerate secure software delivery, and ensure compliance with industry regulations. Black Duck
  provides the visibility, automation, and expert guidance necessary to manage software security
  risks at the speed modern businesses demand.
* How do Black Duck SCA tools protect and monitor software supply chain security and open source
  components?
  
  Black Duck offers comprehensive [software composition analysis (SCA)][122] tools that provide
  complete visibility into every open source and third-party component in your applications. Our
  advanced detection methods can also generate and manage accurate Software Bills of Materials
  (SBOMs), meticulously tracking components and their versions, licenses, and security status to
  ensure transparency and compliance with supply chain regulations. Black Duck continuously monitors
  these components against vulnerability databases, including our proprietary [KnowledgeBase][123]™,
  and automatically alerts your teams to new threats without requiring new scans. By integrating
  directly into CI/CD pipelines, Black Duck solutions prevent vulnerable or noncompliant code from
  advancing, ensuring ongoing supply chain security and enabling rapid response to emerging threats
  and attacks.
* What SAST, DAST, SCA, and AI AppSec testing tools does Black Duck offer?
  
  Black Duck provides a comprehensive and complementary portfolio of application security testing
  (AST) solutions designed to secure both proprietary code and third-party components, including
  AI-generated code, across the entire software development life cycle. Our offerings include
  * **Agentic AI application security.** [Black Duck Signal™][124] combines 20+ years of software
    security expertise and intellectual property with LLM-powered software analysis to autonomously
    detect and remediate vulnerabilities in business-critical applications.
  * **Static application security testing (SAST).** [Black Duck SAST tools][125] provide fast,
    scalable, and comprehensive static code analysis in the cloud ([Polaris fAST Static][126]), on
    premises ([Coverity^{®} Static Analysis][127]), and at the developer desktop ([CodeSight™ IDE
    Plug-in][128]).

# Runtime sees
# what AI does.

## AI is generating your code.
## AI is running the attacks.
## Contrast protects both.

[Try Contrast][66]
[Contrast AI Platform Graph]

## We invented runtime application security.

Our founder helped define how the industry thinks about application security. The patents behind
runtime instrumentation are ours. The category started here.

When AI changed how code gets written and how attacks get launched, we didn't scramble to catch up.
We already had the only security model that works from inside the application. Observing real
behavior, blocking real attacks, in real time.

The AI era didn't change our approach. It proved it was right.

Runtime sees everything. No matter who's attacking it, or who wrote it.

### See exactly which
### vulnerabilities are under attack

The Contrast Graph creates a live map of your application — linking active attacks to specific lines
of code in real time. Know what’s reachable. Know what’s being exploited. Fix what matters.

[Explore the platform][67]

## Watch AI create a vulnerability. Watch runtime security stop it.

1

### AI writes code.

AI-assisted code. Shipped fast.

### Goes live faster.

Through your pipeline.
Not fully validated.
[contrast-tile-icon__02_fixed]
3

### Attack hits.

Real request hits vulnerable code at runtime.
[contrast-tile-icon__03]
4

### Contrast stops it.

Blocked inside the app.
No signatures.
No guesswork.
[contrast-tile-icon__04]
5

### Fix what matters.

Exact path. Real fix. No noise.
[contrast-tile-icon__05]

## Don't take our word for it.

[Read the full case study][70]
Real results from real organizations.
66%

Reduction in CVE triage workload — Backbase

0.2%

False positive rate — measured by an enterprise customer across 21,000 vulnerabilities.

2,000,000

Attacks blocked in a single day. For one Contrast customer.

## The only security model built for how software actually runs

### It sees execution, not assumptions.

It sees execution, not assumptions. Runtime instruments your application from within — observing
every method, every request, every attack path as it actually happens.

### It doesn’t care where the code came from.

Human, AI, open source, library, agentic system — runtime sees what that code does in production

## Technology

CORE is an evolution of the [Web Application Firewall][1] (WAF) technology called [Runtime
Application Self-Protection][2] (RASP). Traditional RASP technologies are required to be integrated
as a framework or module that runs in conjunction with a program's codes, libraries, and system
calls. This requirement limits the type of applications traditional RASP technologies can be
deployed with. CORE does not have any framework requirements and can be deployed with any web
application requiring no modification to existing code bases.

As the name CORE suggests, it works by correcting the request and response data as it ingresses and
egresses the application. This unique and novel method allows for additional protections over other
RASP technologies.

## Protections

### Attacks

Clickjacking

HTTP Response Splitting

HTTP Method Tampering

Large Requests

Malformed Content-Types

Path Traversal

Unvalidated Redirects

### Injections

Command Injection

Cross-Site Scripting

Crose-Site Request Forgery

CSS & HTML Injection

JSON & XML Injection

OGNL Injection

SQL Injection

Database Access Violation

### Weaknesses

Insecure Cookies

Logging Sensitive Information

Unauthenticated Network Activity

Uncaught Exceptions

Vulnerable Dependencies

Weak Authentication

Weak Browser Caching

Weak Cryptography

Mask Confidential Text

Confidential Field Inputs

## History

CORE started off as the open source Stronghenge Web Application Firewall offered as an installable
package in the SUSE Linux distribution until May of 2014. The current WAF/RASP technology is now
closed source and privately licensed with multiple patents in the works.

The first large scale deployment of the current CORE RASP technology was deployed in at the end of
2010 for the United States Federal Government to protect an agency's vulnerable legacy application
for which the original un-compiled source code was lost and rewriting the application would
ultimately take 5 years. During the time it took to rewrite the application, CORE was successfully
able to mitigate all the vulnerabilities discovered with the application.

## Information Request

If you would like to obtain more information about the CORE RASP technology, please contact the
security research and development scientist [Austin Kauffman][3] at akauffman(at)ne4u(dot)com.

**Data Security Summit 2026** merupakan forum strategis yang mempertemukan para pemimpin, praktisi,
dan komunitas profesional di bidang keamanan informasi, tata kelola data, privasi, dan kepatuhan.
Mengusung tema **“Managing Security, Privacy, and Compliance for Secure and Trusted Data-Driven
Organization”**, kegiatan ini dirancang untuk membahas bagaimana organisasi dapat membangun
ekosistem data yang aman, tepercaya, dan sesuai dengan kebutuhan regulasi.

Dalam konteks **DAMA-DMBOK**, **Data Security** merupakan salah satu *knowledge area* utama dalam
praktik manajemen data. Area ini menekankan pentingnya perlindungan aset data dari akses,
penggunaan, perubahan, pengungkapan, atau penghancuran yang tidak sah. Oleh karena itu, keamanan
data tidak hanya dipandang sebagai isu teknologi, tetapi juga sebagai bagian integral dari tata
kelola data, manajemen risiko, kepatuhan, dan pembangunan kepercayaan dalam organisasi berbasis
data.

Melalui kegiatan ini, peserta akan mendapatkan wawasan mengenai peran strategis **data security**
dalam mendukung penerapan **data governance**, perlindungan privasi, kepatuhan terhadap regulasi,
serta pengelolaan risiko data. Diskusi juga akan mengangkat praktik terbaik dan pendekatan terkini
dalam memastikan bahwa data dapat dikelola secara aman, bertanggung jawab, dan bernilai bagi
organisasi.

Data Security Summit 2026 menjadi ruang kolaborasi bagi para profesional untuk bertukar perspektif,
memperluas jejaring, dan memahami bagaimana prinsip-prinsip keamanan data dalam DAMA-DMBOK dapat
diterapkan secara praktis di berbagai sektor industri.

## **Security Starts with Behavior**

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

****AI Agent-Powered TDIR****

Automate and accelerate threat detection, investigation and response (TDIR). An integrated team of
AI agents streamlines the entire TDIR workflow, from enriching threat data to building
evidence-backed timelines. Experience faster and more precise investigations, increasing team
productivity.

[target]

****Insider Threat Coverage for Humans and Agents****

Monitor behavior of both employees and AI agents to gain visibility into this new class of insider
threat. User and entity behavior analytics (UEBA) and Agent Behavior Analytics (ABA) automatically
baseline activity, exposing anomalies that signal an actionable threat.

[outcomes]

****Quantifiable, Outcomes-Focused Security****

Benchmark and prove the value of your security program against peers and measurable outcomes.
Translate raw security data into business-relevant insights to demonstrate progress against your
most strategic use cases, MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, and compliance initiatives.

[sign post]

****Unmatched Customer Choice and Flexibility****

Maximize your investment in best-of-breed security tools with an open platform. Gain a unified view
of your security operation without getting locked into a proprietary scheme. Control costs with
advanced data pipeline management that allows you to search data in place and leverage low-cost

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

# WORKFORCE SOLUTIONS THAT POWER GROWTH

GDH is a global IT staffing and professional services firm committed to always delivering more.
Better talent. More client support. World-class workforce outcomes. Let’s get to work.

[FIND A JOB][37] [EXPLORE GDH STAFFING SOLUTIONS][38]

## Find great jobs across the private and government sectors.

Discover the many reasons to make GDH your career partner. We care about people. We will take you as
far as your professional ambitions reach.

Search

## IT Staffing and Professional Services

### Every hiring initiative has its challenges. GDH has a workforce solution to meet your every
### hiring need:

## [Technology Staffing Solutions **›**][39]

Grow your technology team with expert IT staffing services.

## [Custom Staffing **›**][40]

Engage non-technical talent with custom staffing solutions.

## [Professional Services ****›****][41]

Build top-notch teams to plan, lead, and execute mission-critical business initiatives.

## [RPO **›**][42]

Optimize hiring resources and results with recruitment process outsourcing (RPO).

## **Technology Expertise That Drives Business Outcomes**

GDH helps organizations solve today’s most critical technology challenges through specialized talent
and professional services across:
* Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation
* Data Engineering & Analytics
* Cybersecurity & Risk Management
* Cloud Transformation
* Application Development & Modernization
* DevOps & Platform Engineering
* Network & Infrastructure Services
* Digital Transformation

## THE EXTRA MILE?

## THATS WHERE GDH LIVES.

“GDH has exceeded my team’s expectations and is always a phone call away when questions arise.
Several of the resources GDH provided for my last project are now full-time team members in my
organization. GDH will be my first choice when my next project arises.”

– CHRO, MULTINATIONAL FOOD INDUSTRY LEADER

### **Need to quickly fill contract technology jobs?**

[EXPLORE IT STAFFING][43]

### **Want scalable services customized to your business?**

[EXPLORE CUSTOM][44]

### **Looking to elevate recruitment capabilities and results?**

[EXPLORE RPO][45]

### **Need skilled specialists to support or lead key projects?**

[EXPLORE PROJECT SOLUTIONS][46]

## “Best of” Winner and Trusted Partner to the Fortune 500

[Read our case studies][47] and discover what makes us an annual “Best of Staffing” winner and
Fortune 500 recruiting solutions partner.

## WE CARE ABOUT PEOPLE

Right from the start with GDH you will notice a difference. We’re a company driven by care. Genuine
care for our clients’ businesses and goals. Enthusiastic care for the career and life journeys of
our consultants and employees. Care to us is so much more than a nice idea. It’s fundamental to who
we are and our competitive advantage.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT GDH][48]

## WHAT OUR CLIENTS & CLIENT FACING EMPLOYEES (CFE’S) SAY
* > “GDH does a great job at supporting us… GDH is proactive, responsive, and takes the time to
  > fully understand our requirements and knows our culture and strives to find candidates that meet
  > our needs.”
  
  Large Banking Institute
* > “I have had very good luck with GDH quickly providing several candidates. I have also had very
  > good luck with those who were hired. GDH is my favorite of the talent agencies I work with.”
  
  International Energy Manufacturer
* > “GDH found me a role in a department that aligned with my careeer goals and offered a highly
  > competitive salary. Having the support of awesome people at GDH has been a life saver in my
  > career.”
  
  CFE Placed by GDH
* > “I am incredibly thankful to GDH for their consistent support and encouragement throughout the
  > onboarding process. From interview preparation to finalizing documents answering all my
  > questions, the team was always helpful and responsive. Their professionalism and genuine care
  > truly stood out.”
  
  CFE Placed at a Global Telecommunications Company

# **The highest level of mobile app security with ease**

Multilayered protection unified with automated security testing. Detect threats in real-time and
trust that it’s your app interacting with your APIs. All in a single, intuitive platform.

[Request pricing][141][Discover the guided workflow][142]

## Why Guardsquare is different

Protection and testing combined

* Continuous mobile app security testing combined with multiple reinforcing layers of code hardening
  techniques delivers comprehensive protection.
* Testing provides in-depth code analysis for relevant and actionable insights to fix issues early
  in the development lifecycle.
* Automatically injected RASP checks within the code itself help monitor for suspicious behavior
  when the app is running.

### Multi-layer security for comprehensive, compiler-based protection
* Continuous mobile app security testing combined with multiple reinforcing layers of code hardening
  techniques delivers comprehensive protection.
* Testing provides in-depth code analysis for relevant and actionable insights to fix issues early
  in the development lifecycle.
* Automatically injected RASP checks within the code itself help monitor for suspicious behavior
  when the app is running.

Guardsquare’s products incorporate the full spectrum of mobile app security technology, including:
* Multiple layers of protection
  that reinforce one another and redundantly protect your app through defense in depth.
* Automatically injected RASP checks
  that are inserted into random locations in your code and at a higher volume than is possible with
  manual injection.
* Polymorphic protection
  which ensures that your mobile app security defenses automatically change with each build, forcing
  attackers to start over.

Ease of integration

#### Seamless implementation
* Guardsquare’s innovative, guided approach to implementing comprehensive mobile app security
  ensures ease and efficiency.
* Fine-tune advanced protection settings so security-sensitive code and assets are fully protected.

[Discover our guided workflow][143]

### Slide Headline Here
* Guardsquare’s innovative, guided approach to implementing comprehensive mobile app security
  ensures ease and efficiency.
* Fine-tune advanced protection settings so security-sensitive code and assets are fully protected.

Guardsquare's security solutions incorporate the full spectrum of mobile app security technology,
including: 
* Multiple layers of code hardening
  
  which replaces the names of classes, functions and variables with meaningless alternatives
* Injected RASP checks
  
  which conceals the logical structure of the app and makes it more difficult to determine how it
  functions
* Polymorphic protection
  
  ensuring that your mobile app security defenses change each time a threat actor attempts to
  reverse engineer or tamper with your app.

Security without compromise

* Designed specifically for mobile applications.
* Continuous testing and compiler-based protections weave security throughout the development
  process.
* Apply comprehensive security without disrupting mobile app performance, UX, or delivery cycles.

WHAT AGENTS GET

## One gateway. Every data source. Full control.

Agents access the data they need. You control what they can do. No per-protocol setup. No rule sets
to maintain per data source.

Data Masking

Agents reach sensitive data without seeing what they should not. PII, credentials, and financial
records masked at the wire before the agent processes the response. No schema changes. No
application rewrites. Agents get the data. Humans get the redactions.

[Learn more →][9]
Guardrails

Agents operate with guardrails, not handcuffs. Destructive commands blocked at the gateway before
execution. The agent keeps working on everything it is allowed to do. Security teams find out from
reports, not incidents.

[Learn more →][10]
AI Analysis

Every agent session is classified by risk automatically. Anomalous access patterns are flagged
before they become incidents. You see what agents are actually doing across production, not what
logs approximate.

[Learn more →][11]
Command Approval

High-risk agent actions pause for human review. Approval in Slack, ticket in Jira, escalation in
Teams. Agents stay unblocked on everything else. No one watches a dashboard at 3 AM.

[Learn more →][12]

“Developers got autonomy. Security got auditability. We stopped choosing between the two.”

[EBANX]

HOW IT WORKS IN PRACTICE

## Agents that can reach anything. Zero incidents.

The Blocked Use Case

The head of AI wants agents querying the transaction database. Compliance says no. The data is too
sensitive. Hoop deploys in front of the database. PII is masked at the wire. The agent gets the data
it needs. Compliance gets the audit trail. The project ships.

The AI Agent

An AI agent queried production. Sensitive fields were masked before the agent processed the
response. A destructive command was blocked at the gateway. The agent kept working on everything it
was allowed to do. The security team found out from the weekly report, not a 3 AM page.

The MCP Problem

Twelve data sources. Twelve MCP gateways. Twelve rule sets to maintain. One legacy protocol MCP does
not support. Hoop replaces all of it. One gateway, transparent at the wire, one rule set that covers
every protocol. Oracle included.

“Zero setup for GDPR, SOC2, and PCI across our databases, Kubernetes clusters, and AWS accounts. We
replaced our in-house tool in a week.”

[RD Station]

“Manual financial operations were our biggest bottleneck. Hoop automated access, eliminated human
error, and gave us audit trails that are regulator-ready in real time.”

[Dock]

## Your AI roadmap is blocked by data access risk. Hoop removes the block.

A 30-minute walkthrough shows exactly how fast your agents can reach data they cannot touch today.

[See a demo →][13]

# Long 80

Neurealm + Premier Inc. JV

### Over*view*

Long 80 is a joint collaboration between Neurealm (formerly GS Lab | GAVS) and Premier Inc.,
established to drive technology-enabled transformation across the U.S. healthcare ecosystem. Long 80
brings together deep healthcare domain expertise and cutting-edge AI-led IT services to deliver
measurable outcomes in care quality, operational efficiency, and innovation.

Backed by Premier’s extensive network of 4,000+ hospitals and 175,000 providers, and powered by
Neurealm’s digital engineering and AIOps capabilities, Long 80 is committed to co-developing
impactful, IP-led solutions that advance healthcare delivery and system resilience.

> “Moving from a vendor-only model with Neurealm to a collaborative model through Long 80 expands
> Premier’s current technology portfolio, enabling us to offer Neurealm’s technology, digital
> transformation and data security services and solutions to U.S. healthcare organizations. We are
> extremely excited about this opportunity and look forward to further developing our relationship
> with Neurealm”
> 
> Leigh AndersonPresident - Performance Services Premier, Inc.

## Offerings

##### AI Led Managed Services
* AIOps Platform – ZIF
* Zdesk – Secure virtual desktop
* Digital Service Desk
* Datacenter as a Service

[Learn More][59]

##### Cybersecurity
* Assessment & Advisory
* Identity & Access Management
* Threat Detection & Response
* Managed Services
* Risk & Compliance

[Learn More][60]

* Migration & Transformation
* Orchestration & Management
* Azure Cloud Services
* Microsoft 365 Integration

[Learn More][61]

[Ambient Clinical Intelligence]

##### Clinical Application Services
* Supply Chain
* Quality Improvement
* Pharmacy
* Population Health
* Finance & Operations
* Data & Analytics
* Applied Science

* EHR Implementation
* EHR Support
* EHR Integration
* EHR on Cloud

[Learn More][63]

[Management, Upgrades, Support]

##### Integration & Interoperability
* Consulting
* Implementation
* Integration
* Support

[Learn More][64]

## Why Long 80?

With our AI-led offerings purpose-built for the healthcare industry, we are committed to
accelerating digital transformation through advanced artificial intelligence. Powered by proprietary
AI platforms, tools, and solution accelerators, we help create a secure, resilient, and scalable
healthcare IT infrastructure. Our AIOps platform drives tangible business outcomes by enhancing
operational efficiency, ensuring system reliability, and proactively managing risks.
* Increased service availability due to the prevention of IT outages
* Savings in investments and cost of operations, enabled by automation
* Enhanced customer experience due to predictable uptime
* Faster Time to Market (TTM) due to digital transformation and improved agility

# Long 80

Neurealm + Premier Inc. JV

### Over*view*

Long 80 is a joint collaboration between Neurealm (formerly GS Lab | GAVS) and Premier Inc.,
established to drive technology-enabled transformation across the U.S. healthcare ecosystem. Long 80
brings together deep healthcare domain expertise and cutting-edge AI-led IT services to deliver
measurable outcomes in care quality, operational efficiency, and innovation.

Backed by Premier’s extensive network of 4,000+ hospitals and 175,000 providers, and powered by
Neurealm’s digital engineering and AIOps capabilities, Long 80 is committed to co-developing
impactful, IP-led solutions that advance healthcare delivery and system resilience.

> “Moving from a vendor-only model with Neurealm to a collaborative model through Long 80 expands
> Premier’s current technology portfolio, enabling us to offer Neurealm’s technology, digital
> transformation and data security services and solutions to U.S. healthcare organizations. We are
> extremely excited about this opportunity and look forward to further developing our relationship
> with Neurealm”

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists who met at the European Organization for Nuclear Research
(CERN) and shared a vision for a more secure and private internet. We believe in technical
excellence, integrity, and transparency.

Proton is led by scientists, including Sir Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, and
we work for the public good.

### Advanced Cybersecurity Solutions

In today's digital landscape, cyber threats evolve constantly. RedFox delivers cutting-edge security

### The Modern Threat Landscape

**We live in a connected world where** your phone talks to your car, your watch monitors your
health, and your home knows when you're coming.

**We live in a connected world where** everything is instant, accessible, and at your fingertips.

**We live in a connected world where** transactions happen in milliseconds and information travels
at the speed of light.

**We live in a connected world where** digital interactions shape every aspect of our daily lives.

But behind this digital convenience lurks a hidden reality.

**DID YOU KNOW?**
* While you read this sentence, 4 new malware variants were created
* Last year, hackers stole more identities than there are people in Australia
* Every minute, phishing scams swipe $17,700 – and keep coming back
* A cyber attack occurs every 39 seconds somewhere in the world
* Cybercriminals earn $1.5 trillion annually - more than most countries' GDP


**Every click, every download, every connection makes our lives easier. But it also makes us
vulnerable.**

The threats are the same whether you're an individual or a business - malware that steals, phishing
that deceives, and ransomware that destroys.

### WHY REDFOX?

Cybercriminals today deploy sophisticated attack vectors targeting every digital touchpoint. From
mobile devices to enterprise networks, no system is immune to evolving threats such as advanced
malware, ransomware, phishing attacks, and social engineering tactics.

**Beyond Traditional Security**
While conventional security measures address known threats, modern cybersecurity requires proactive
defense mechanisms. Today's attackers leverage AI, zero-day exploits, and multi-vector approaches
that demand equally advanced protection strategies.

**RedFox Advantage**
Our security ecosystem combines real-time threat detection, behavioral analysis, and predictive
intelligence to stay ahead of emerging risks. Whether protecting personal privacy or enterprise
infrastructure, RedFox delivers comprehensive security that evolves with the threat landscape.

**Proven Protection Philosophy**
We believe security should be robust yet invisible, comprehensive yet user-friendly. Our solutions
integrate seamlessly into your digital workflow while providing enterprise-grade protection that
scales from individual users to large organizations.

### OUR SOLUTIONS

RedFox delivers tailored cybersecurity solutions designed for the unique needs of individuals and
enterprises. Our platform combines cutting-edge technology with intuitive design to provide
comprehensive protection across all digital environments.
[Individual Security Solutions]

#### Individual Protection

Comprehensive cybersecurity solutions designed for personal use. Protect your computer, mobile
devices, personal data, and digital identity with our consumer-focused security applications.
* Mobile Security & Antivirus
* Mobile Anti-Phishing & Scam Detection
* Desktop Phishing Protection (Windows & Mac)
* Identity Protection

[EXPLORE PERSONAL SOLUTIONS][10]
[Enterprise Security Solutions]

#### Enterprise Protection

Advanced cybersecurity solutions for businesses and organizations. Protect your workforce, data, and
operations with enterprise-grade security infrastructure and intelligent threat detection.
* PhishIQ - Smart Security Platform
* Desktop Anti-Phishing & Threat Monitoring
* Mobile Security Solutions
* Centralized Management & Analytics

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

  credential that reflects what you can actually do on the job, proof of real-world readiness that

deep understanding of interdependencies and downstream impacts, we enable teams to seamlessly adopt
and integrate DevSecOps practices, resulting in robust and secure applications. Our solutions
accelerate transformation, allowing businesses to stay ahead of the curve and achieve their goals
with confidence.

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and
measurable operational value.

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

[READ THE REPORT][167]

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response

# Built for Advantage

One AI-native platform. Unified protection across endpoint, identity, AI, and cloud. Built to give
defenders the edge back, so they don't just keep up, they stay ahead.

[Free Platform Demo][75][See It in Action][76]

## AI changed everything.
## The threat landscape included.

Attackers now use AI to generate code, move at machine speed, and exploit gaps. The old model was
built for a slower era. That era is over.

[Floating translucent dashboard cards on a purple-violet gradient, showing 45%, 465, “Purple AI
Summary…”, and a white bar chart]
0202

## The AI era demands a new advantage. SentinelOne delivers it.

One platform powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence. Built to stop emerging threats at machine
speed and give defenders the upper hand.

The AI-Native Cybersecurity Platform

## Built for Defenders.
## Engineered for Advantage.

Endpoint & Identity SecuritySecuring AICloud SecurityAutonomous SOCGlobal Services
[Dark cybersecurity dashboard with menu text (Global, SentinelOne, Kyber Cyber, Select Group),

### Protect Every Device. Secure Every Identity.

Autonomously stop supply chain, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse with AI-native
endpoint and identity protection unified in a single lightweight agent.
* Stop threats at machine speed with behavioral AI
* Detect and disrupt identity-based attacks in real time
* Real-time, AI-automated response and remediation
* Deploy in SaaS, on-premises, hybrid, and air-gapped environments

[Explore Endpoint Security][77][See Singularity Identity][78]

[See Industry Recognition][79]
[Purple-violet abstract gradient with glowing cross lines and the word Gartner followed by a dot]

For the sixth consecutive year, SentinelOne is named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™
for Endpoint Protection Platforms.

[Read the Report][80]

[Explore the Singularity Platform][83]

### Protection That Moves at Machine Speed

Detect, contain, and respond to threats in real time with AI-native protection. AI that does more
than protect your business. It protects the AI your business relies on.

Human Amplification

### Less Noise. More Impact from Every Analyst

Purple AI and agentic workflows handle triage, correlation, and routine response so analysts can
focus on higher-value decisions.

Intuitive by Design

### Faster Decisions. Simpler Operations.

A unified experience that brings visibility, investigation, and action together in a single console
so your team can move faster with less friction.

## EXPERT CYBERSECURITY SOLUTIONS PROVIDER FOR GROWING COMPANIES

WE PROTECT GREAT COMPANIES AND THEIR PEOPLE

Your organization is unique. But all too often, cost concerns force mid-market companies to settle
for cookie cutter solutions. Silent Sector provides unbiased vendor and technology-neutral
cybersecurity assessments, guidance, managed cybersecurity services, and program implementation to
keep your company compliant and ahead of the threats. We design solutions for mid-market and
emerging companies in the healthcare, financial services, technology, education, manufacturing, and
defense industries.

[An illustration of virtual data-1]

### Expertise Impact Methodology

Our experts become an extension of your organization

Silent Sector's unique Expertise Impact Model™ streamlines cost and response time by putting you in
direct contact with the experts you need.  Using an asymmetrical warfare approach based on US Army
Special Forces experience, our Expertise Impact Model maximizes capabilities of your internal and
external resources.  This force multiplication methodology also focuses on getting the most value
from your existing software and hardware.  It’s how Silent Sector delivers the high level of
proficiency typically only available to large enterprises, right-sized for the budgets of mid-market
and emerging organizations who need it most.

# Security at the *Speed of Thought*

**In an era of instant coding filled with AI-generated vulnerabilities, Waratek offers the only
compiler-based runtime application tools that report 100% of exploitable vulnerabilities in the
pre-production pipeline and block attacks in production against known and Zero Day flaws.**

Stop Chasing Vulnerabilities.
Start Fixing Them.

[Schedule Your Personalized Demo →][11][Layered security shields protecting a glowing application
core]

## Why Runtime Security?

In today’s accelerated development landscape, security teams are often trapped in an endless cycle
of reaction-chasing down alerts, triaging false positives, and scrambling to patch vulnerabilities
long after code has been deployed.

Waratek disrupts this cycle by offering the industry’s only compiler-based, runtime application
security platform. By embedding security directly into the application's runtime, we provide tools
that not only find vulnerabilities with precision during the pre-production development pipeline but
also instantly block attacks in production against both known and unknown threats. Unlike perimeter
defenses, Waratek provides:
* **Deep Context:** Full visibility into application logic.
* **Accuracy:** 100% detection with zero false positives.

## The Shift Left / Shield Right Framework

In an era of rapid deployment and sophisticated threats, traditional security testing is no longer
enough. Waratek delivers the industry’s only unified Shift Left and Shield Right strategy.

By moving security into the runtime, we eliminate the friction between development and security,
providing ultra-accurate test results and instant, immutable protection in production.
* **Shift Left (Waratek IAST):** Finding and fixing vulnerabilities during development and QA.
* **Shield Right (Waratek RASP):** Protecting live production environments from real-time exploits,
  Zero Day, and AI-driven attacks.

[Shift Left / Shield Right framework diagram: Waratek IAST finds vulnerabilities during development;
Waratek RASP blocks attacks in production]

# Security at the *Speed of Thought*

**In an era of instant coding filled with AI-generated vulnerabilities, Waratek offers the only
compiler-based runtime application tools that report 100% of exploitable vulnerabilities in the
pre-production pipeline and block attacks in production against known and Zero Day flaws.**

Stop Chasing Vulnerabilities.
Start Fixing Them.

[Schedule Your Personalized Demo →][11][Layered security shields protecting a glowing application
core]

## Why Runtime Security?

In today’s accelerated development landscape, security teams are often trapped in an endless cycle
of reaction-chasing down alerts, triaging false positives, and scrambling to patch vulnerabilities
long after code has been deployed.

Waratek disrupts this cycle by offering the industry’s only compiler-based, runtime application
security platform. By embedding security directly into the application's runtime, we provide tools
that not only find vulnerabilities with precision during the pre-production development pipeline but
also instantly block attacks in production against both known and unknown threats. Unlike perimeter
defenses, Waratek provides:
* **Deep Context:** Full visibility into application logic.
* **Accuracy:** 100% detection with zero false positives.

## The Shift Left / Shield Right Framework

In an era of rapid deployment and sophisticated threats, traditional security testing is no longer
enough. Waratek delivers the industry’s only unified Shift Left and Shield Right strategy.

By moving security into the runtime, we eliminate the friction between development and security,
providing ultra-accurate test results and instant, immutable protection in production.
* **Shift Left (Waratek IAST):** Finding and fixing vulnerabilities during development and QA.
* **Shield Right (Waratek RASP):** Protecting live production environments from real-time exploits,
  Zero Day, and AI-driven attacks.

[Shift Left / Shield Right framework diagram: Waratek IAST finds vulnerabilities during development;
Waratek RASP blocks attacks in production]

# Improve
# Cyber Security Literacy & ditch the jargon; we speak your language

By leveraging diverse expertise from government, academia, and industry, we ensure that our
resources resonate with a wide audience, empowering them to navigate cyber threats confidently. Join
us in this mission to transform cybersecurity awareness into actionable knowledge for everyone!
[ Schedule a Meeting ][44]
The place where cyber security expertise meets accessibility

# Dejargnizing Tomorrow's Cybersecurity

You won’t believe the pitfalls some firms fall into: paying a fortune for services they need, losing
precious months due to project delays, and facing an escalating risk of security breaches.

Our integrated approach combines Education, Advisory, Awareness, and Vendor-Business Mediation to
break down silos, demystify cybersecurity, and turn risks into strategic advantages.

**Get matched for free with specialized guidance and cybersecurity compliance advisory and
consulting services to help you navigate the complexities of meeting and sustaining framework
compliance.**

### Confusion, Cost & Chaos:
### What’s Wrong with Buying Cybersecurity Today

#### Inconsistent Terminology

🚫 76% of cybersecurity decision-makers admit they struggle to differentiate between vendor
offerings like vulnerability assessments, pen tests, and risk reviews.

For example, a "penetration test" typically implies an ethical hacker is actively trying to exploit
vulnerabilities to assess how deep they can get. But some vendors may label an automated
vulnerability scan—which is far less thorough—as a "penetration test.
* Impact?

Businesses pay for services that don’t address their actual risks (e.g., believing they’re getting a
thorough security assessment but receiving a superficial scan).

##### Scope Creep and Budget Overruns

Penetration testing quotes can vary by 5x or more for the same scope—from $2,000 to $15,000.
(Cybersecurity Buyer Report, Network Assured, 2023).

43% of companies report hidden costs like “remediation consulting” or vague post-engagement support.
A "risk assessment" might exclude critical systems, forcing businesses to pay extra for follow-up
work. Vendors may also upsell mid-project. Cybersecurity engagements often suffer from scope creep
(unplanned tasks) or poorly defined deliverables.
* Impact

Projects exceed timelines and budgets, eroding trust and diverting funds from other priorities.

##### Unaddressed Cyber Risks

The culmination of the above problems. Businesses end up with fragmented or ineffective
solutions—like a compliance audit that ignores ransomware readiness—leaving critical gaps (e.g.,
unpatched servers, weak access controls).
* Impact

Organizations remain vulnerable to breaches, fines, and operational disruption despite spending on
“cybersecurity.”

##### Buzzword-Heavy Marketing, not real answers

48% of cybersecurity projects either fail to meet expectations or go over budget/scope.

(CSO Online, 2022 Survey)Vendors rely on vague terms like "AI-powered" or "military-grade security"
without explaining how these apply to the client’s unique needs. For example, "zero-trust
architecture" might be touted without clarifying if it’s relevant for a small e-commerce site.
* Impact

Decision-makers waste time deciphering jargon and may invest in unnecessary or mismatched solutions.

##### Opaque and Inconsistent Pricing

One vendor might charge $2,000 for a vulnerability scan, while another quotes $15,000 for what
appears to be the same service.

On top of that, hidden fees—such as “remediation consulting” or “report customization”—often inflate
the final cost, catching businesses off guard and eroding trust.
* Impact

Budgets spiral out of control, and businesses struggle to compare vendors or justify ROI.

## Cybersecurity Procurement is Broken – The Data Proves It

Businesses lack the expertise to navigate this landscape alone. We connect them to MSSPs

Our unique value lies in our curated, human-first approach. While many cybersecurity providers focus
on technical jargon or one-size-fits-all packages, we prioritize understanding your business,
industry, and pain points first. We recognize that a mid-sized healthcare clinic in Texas faces
vastly different threats than a SaaS startup scaling in Toronto—and that a regional credit union’s
compliance needs aren’t the same as a manufacturing plant’s operational technology risks.

energy, and beyond.**

### Confusion, Cost & Chaos:
### What’s Wrong with Buying Cybersecurity Today

#### Inconsistent Terminology

🚫 76% of cybersecurity decision-makers admit they struggle to differentiate between vendor
offerings like vulnerability assessments, pen tests, and risk reviews.

For example, a "penetration test" typically implies an ethical hacker is actively trying to exploit
vulnerabilities to assess how deep they can get. But some vendors may label an automated
vulnerability scan—which is far less thorough—as a "penetration test.
* Impact?

Businesses pay for services that don’t address their actual risks (e.g., believing they’re getting a
thorough security assessment but receiving a superficial scan).

##### Scope Creep and Budget Overruns

Penetration testing quotes can vary by 5x or more for the same scope—from $2,000 to $15,000.
(Cybersecurity Buyer Report, Network Assured, 2023).

43% of companies report hidden costs like “remediation consulting” or vague post-engagement support.
A "risk assessment" might exclude critical systems, forcing businesses to pay extra for follow-up
work. Vendors may also upsell mid-project. Cybersecurity engagements often suffer from scope creep
(unplanned tasks) or poorly defined deliverables.
* Impact

Projects exceed timelines and budgets, eroding trust and diverting funds from other priorities.

##### Unaddressed Cyber Risks

The culmination of the above problems. Businesses end up with fragmented or ineffective
solutions—like a compliance audit that ignores ransomware readiness—leaving critical gaps (e.g.,
unpatched servers, weak access controls).
* Impact

Organizations remain vulnerable to breaches, fines, and operational disruption despite spending on
“cybersecurity.”

##### Buzzword-Heavy Marketing, not real answers

48% of cybersecurity projects either fail to meet expectations or go over budget/scope.

(CSO Online, 2022 Survey)Vendors rely on vague terms like "AI-powered" or "military-grade security"
without explaining how these apply to the client’s unique needs. For example, "zero-trust
architecture" might be touted without clarifying if it’s relevant for a small e-commerce site.
* Impact

Decision-makers waste time deciphering jargon and may invest in unnecessary or mismatched solutions.

##### Opaque and Inconsistent Pricing

One vendor might charge $2,000 for a vulnerability scan, while another quotes $15,000 for what
appears to be the same service.

On top of that, hidden fees—such as “remediation consulting” or “report customization”—often inflate
the final cost, catching businesses off guard and eroding trust.
* Impact

Budgets spiral out of control, and businesses struggle to compare vendors or justify ROI.

traffic.
